title: VXAce Various Ideas of What's Next

posts.author: InsaneSufferer333
posts.body:
Being done with my latest game and over with entire d̴̻̦͖̤̤̱̠̟͎̝̺̈́͜ȉ̴̡̨̛͉͍̳̲̩̣̫͙̤̭͇̭́̆̀͛̅̊̿̅̈̚͜͠ș̴̨̡̣͎̗͍̜̯͍͇̗̗̱͕̦̪͈̬̲̼̼̻̱͖̣̝̼̖̈́̄̉̿͋̽̓̓́͌͑͆̈́͊́͝ͅä̶̢̖͍̳̦̮̭̦̫̹̞̱̭̱̰̬̮͕͎͖́͐̂̐͂͜p̸̧̲̥̖͈̳̹̈́̓̅̿́̓̐́̾p̷̞͂̋̈́͋̄͒̌̂̓͑̐̔̏̐̎͑̈́͂͛́̒̂̓̕͝͝o̷̢̙͕̞̙̭̬̣͙͍͕͈̼͙̠̣͂͗̾͐̾̅̔̕͘͠î̵̛͕̲͈͔̹̌̓̏͛̿͑̋̔̀͋̈́̀̌̃̌͆̔̄̋̍͆̈̄͠͝ͅṇ̴̟̜̆̽̂̓̉̾̊̿̓̀̀̽̽́͛̽͊͌̈́̉̈̽̍́͘̕͜ţ̴̣̼̻͕̹̱̊̇̄̍͂̂̂̏̽̆̈́͊̃͋m̵̧̥̺̲̱̖̗͎̪̜̙̑͗ͅȩ̷̧̨̛̰̜̪̩̲͙̬̯̖̱̤̍͋͛̊̏͗̔̾͌̑̋̾̒͜͝͝͠ͅͅn̶̨̛̛͔̘̩̦̙̗̺͍̞͉̰͎̭̯̩̮̞̺̽̏͒̿̾́͗̎́͘͘̕͝ͅͅţ̶̧̢̛̺̠͉͕̺̙͕͉͙̝̖͗̄̀̈́͊̍͊̎́̀̾͛̓̽̿̔̔͗̾̈́̽̓͗̄̚̕͘̚ͅ ̷͔̮̼̭͕̮͌̚͝p̵̡̧̛͓̬̪̬̮͍̬̗̼͇̙̙͍̙̥̣͑̓͂̿̍̉̾̂͒͐̋̿̍̚͘ͅh̵̢̡̡̘̻̗̙̀́̐̍̀̑̎̈́͘a̴̡̤̭̱͇̮̹͕͋̊͑̽̂́̍͋̕s̷̡̧͈̭͓̫͓̪̼̤̱͇̝̜̞̖̺̣͇̣̟̯̠̘̞̯͖̿̉͒̓̂͌͊ͅͅe̷̢̡̬̗͖̜̮͎͖͉͚̖̦͖̳͇̖̞͙̘͉̖̻̒̓̒͑̃͊͋̂̓͂͋͊̇̇̽͛͒́̆͊͋͒̅͋͝ͅͅ
I'd like to maybe eventually go further. Better. Revive the passion.
Share. Live.
Be past fatal mistakes, isolation and all toxic advices gotten on the way.
Let's start with sorting things out.
OPTIONS:
(listed in no particular order except big big smol smol)
1. Screw unique gameplay and puzzles and structure of RPG maker game. Visual Novel. Pure chaos.
Pros:
- Broader use of various weird aesthetics.
- Focus on writing and characters without bothering about game mechanics.
Cons:
- Most unpredictable outcome.
- I'm not native speaker, which means it
might
need proofreading.
2. Make regular Yume Nikki fangame, just stylized. Rage. Speed. Psychodelic smiles. Staggering contrast between grim photorealistic "real world" and sharp mixed "dreamworld".
Pros:
- Defined genre.
- Could be played since early development. No need to wait for game's completion.
Cons:
- Not much plot/lore to throw in.
- Not all details are planned, such as how much would it stick to the formula.
3. Contribute to
One Map Challenge
with piece of previous project.
This point need piece of history. Project directly before Mr T was abandoned in 2021 because it was too big. It was planned to have neighborhood with 40 houses, several side plots to the main plot about discovering mysteries of strange abandoned surreal place outside of reality, and on top of that dreamworld with going to sleep transporting into one of many surreal/abstract scenarios. It got the empty neghborhood
(that's a HUGE map, and by that I mean it!)
, few other places and 4 "dreamworld" minigames.
One of them was turned into small game back then
.
Out of other three
(randomized starting points of the main project btw)
, one by chance almost meets requirements of One Map Challenge. The only things to do is to put it into empty project, swap dancing flowers events for stationary flowers from tileset and check everything to work.
Spoiler:
SCREENSHOT
Pros:
- Easiest to make.
- Good piece of game won't get wasted.
- Remember, eat your dessert even if it stares back.
4. Contribute to One Map Challenge with a maze.
Quite inspiring challenge, isn't it?
Find keys and get out. It's this simple.
Pros:
- Easy to make.
- Planned how would it look like.
Cons:
- Plot isn't fleshed out yet.
